question: As per the Swiss organisation IQAir's 'World Air Quality Report, 2020', which of the following is the most polluted capital city in the world?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Delhi__**.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• As per the Swiss organisation IQAir's '**World Air Quality Report, 2020**',** Delhi** is the** most polluted capital city in the world**.
 
• The 2021 World Air Quality Report for the fourth consecutive year finds **New Delhi as the most polluted capital city** (**and fourth most polluted city**) in the World followed by **Dhaka in Bangladesh, N’Djamena in Chad, Dushanbe in Tajikistan and Muscat in Oman**.
 
• New Delhi saw a** 14.6% increase in PM2.5 **concentrations in 2021 with levels rising to **96.4 μg/m3 from 84 μg/m3 in 2020**.
 
• India also continues to feature prominently among the most polluted cities – with **35 of the top 50 **most polluted cities being in India.
 
• While India’s annual average **PM2.5 levels reached 58.1 μg/m3 in 2021**, ending a three-year trend of improving air quality. India’s annual PM2.5 averages have now returned to pre-quarantine concentrations as measured in 2019.
 
• Alarmingly, in 2021, NONE of the Indian cities met the prescribed World Health Organization (WHO) standards of **5 μg/m3. 48% **of India’s cities **exceeded 50 μg/m3 or more than 10 times the WHO guidelines**.
